definitions.peak: vertex of the least-squares parabola through the raw per-step density on the region (inside the design's basin) where the 5-step-smoothed density is >= 90% of its maximum; SE = delete-one-batch jackknife with the window held fixed (FK: 42 batches of 5000 paths; DK: 20 chunks of 5e4 walkers); peaks_argmax_smoothed5 = secondary argmax estimator
definitions.basins: cuts 0 < valleys of the design's EM-exact free clock G < tmax = 4
definitions.peak_error: achieved peak time - target time T_j
definitions.mass_err_equal: max_j |M_j - mean_j M_j| (equal-mass target at the achieved total)
definitions.mass_err_pstar: max_j |M_j - p*(B,m)| (Box 2 limit-law target at the nominal stripes)
